content.comment_body: I put together a project and printed the entire thing, but noticed that some items were missing. The network blocks show up in the block layout, however, in the block list, a few of them don't appear. There are 22 NQs, but only 16 are visible in the list, and the single NI1 doesn't show up at all. Am I missing a step here?
Actually, disregard my previous question; it appears that adding block comments resolves the issue.

analysis.insight_summary: A user found that some network blocks were absent from the printed block list, while they appeared in the block layout. Upon investigation, it was determined that blocks without comments were not included in the list.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects every network block in a project to be listed in both the block layout and block list on printed documentation, regardless of whether block comments have been added.
